note: Hand-recorded judgements for experiments/repo-scout/rank.mjs. boundaries: strong = the project declares its modules or contexts in code or manifests AND states or enforces the rule between them; medium = declared modules (e.g. NestJS @Module per feature) with no stated or enforced rule between them; weak = folder conventions only; none. tscVerified: the repository's own type check or build was run here with its dependencies installed and passed.

medusa.boundaryEvidence: One package per Medusa module under packages/modules/ (30 Module(Modules.X) definitions); the isolation rule is documented (www/apps/book/app/learn/fundamentals/modules/isolation: a module cannot resolve another module's services or models; cross-module work goes through workflows and module links); each module's service interface is published in packages/core/types/src/<module>/service.ts.
medusa.tsc: own build: 13/13 packages (product module, core-flows and their dependencies) pass `tsc --build`
medusa.licenceNote: MIT except the Enterprise Edition materials named in ENTERPRISE-LICENSE.md; packages/modules and packages/core are MIT

backstage.boundaryEvidence: ADR011 (docs/architecture-decisions) fixes the plugin package structure (x-backend, x-backend-module-*, x-node, x-common); every package.json declares backstage.role (18 backend-plugin, 78 backend-plugin-module, 31 node-library, 23 common-library, ...); the lint rule @backstage/no-mixed-plugin-imports forbids a backend plugin importing another backend plugin; 17 ADR files.
backstage.tsc: own check: `yarn tsc` over the whole monorepo passes, 0 errors (164 s)

novu.boundaryEvidence: apps/api has one NestJS feature module per folder under src/app (64 @Module declarations), use cases under usecases/, persistence in libs/dal (one repository and entity per collection); no ADR or enforced rule for the API (the 7 ADRs and CONTEXT.md files describe the SDK packages, not the API).
novu.tsc: partly: libs/dal, packages/shared and libs/application-generic pass their own `tsc` build; the apps/api type check was not reproduced (filtered install: 889 errors, 575 of them unbuilt workspace or enterprise packages)
novu.licenceNote: MIT outside enterprise/ (LICENSE-ENTERPRISE); apps/api and libs/dal, libs/application-generic are MIT

amplication.boundaryEvidence: packages/amplication-server: 59 NestJS @Module declarations, one folder per feature under src/core; the Nx enforce-module-boundaries rule is configured with sourceTag '*' / onlyDependOnLibsWithTags ['*'], i.e. no constraint.
amplication.tsc: not verified with dependencies; without them 524 non-module errors
